features.quote: Don't over-tune the rig to provoke spirals. If you engineer maximally demoralizing failure messages, you measure your rig's cruelty, not the model. Keep failure outputs realistic and neutral.
features.justification_quote: you measure your rig's cruelty, not the model. Keep failure outputs realistic and neutral.

features.quote: Turn budget: 20–25 agent turns. Enough for drift to emerge; early stability eval research suggests register shifts often appear after ~6–10 consecutive failures.
features.justification_quote: Enough for drift to emerge; early stability eval research suggests register shifts often appear after ~6–10 consecutive failures.

features.quote: Deception risk in rigging. You're lying to the model about solvability. That's fine for an eval, but document it.
